name: lab
description: ML-lab rigor. supervisor: the rulebook and sign-off: thirteen rules (one recorded difference between arms, prediction first, controls, noise floor, leakage, a validated instrument, the freeze, a script-written run record), each with the evidence that shows it, asked before launch and before a number is quoted. experiment: run one experiment (fine-tune, RL, LLM eval or judge) through its stages: prior art, a dated plan page, an attack before spend, a slow-start ladder, a claim-first report. prereg: preregister a comparison before it runs: numeric predictions with fixed denominators, commit and diff stamped, arm-parity check, then predicted vs observed.
